\f[facemom]\rWelcome back home, honey! I'm so proud of you for competing in the World Cup.
\f[facemom]\rYou've grown so much already!\nBut no matter how far you go, you'll always be my little champion!
\f[faceprofElm]\bHey \PN, welcome back! I watched your battles in the Pokemon World Cup! Impressive work out there!
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou’ve come a long way since your early days as a Trainer. But you know, Pokemon research never stops.

[faceprofElm] Actually, Professor Oak reached out recently, and he’s been working on a new research.
He specifically asked for your help.
When you’re ready, head over to his lab in Pallet Town.
I’m sure he’ll fill you in on the details!
